workpackReviews.reason: WP01 has contract-only policy source APIs with caller-supplied authority and no non-test durable source registration/query caller. Production authority requires the Cloudflare WP06 durable identity boundary (which consumes Account Identity WP08) plus Device Trust WP01 trusted-device context and WP03 parent step-up context. This review records hard prerequisites only; it does not claim any owner workpack, policy code, tests, proof, or readiness complete.

The deterministic compiler contracts cannot become a shipped production composition until Policy WP01 owns an authoritative source registration and active-version query boundary. This review does not claim compiler callers, persistence, delivery, tests, proof, or readiness complete.

Removing fabricated AI policy authority has no separate code-writing prerequisite, but the product handoff explicitly delegates policy authority to the Policy compiler contract; keep that exact owner dependency visible.

WP09 is the bounded production foundation for the network consumer chain. Current source implements exact-source ingestion publish, deterministic phase identity/idempotency and refs, recovered ProductionFile journaling before listener readiness, startup/recurring reconciliation, projection-only reads, and real parent-assistant/portal direct-enforcement mutation negatives. Reviewed roots cover capture ingestion, ActivityStore/runtime, agent-core runtime, agent-service delivery/read-model ownership, and the shared Tauri/dev-web portal command boundary; fixture/prove/TEST network_event_runtime files are not shipped production topology. Queue/request-response helpers have no shipped network-consumer caller and are not fake-wired. Focused tests and local ignored proof are green, while the final combined pre-commit, accepted commit, CI, review, and merge remain open. This status does not mark WP09 done or unblock Network WP04.

WP10 has typed structural validation and a private authorization token, but its production resolver always returns unavailable, no shipped peer transport reaches it, and no durable cross-device message custody exists. LAN WP26 owns the authenticated ingress, selected non-revoked route composition, durable duplicate/idempotency custody, and private authority handoff required before WP10 can republish imported events.

The live EventEnvelope generic remains publicly unconstrained and stored decode checks only the event contract, not decoded aggregate/idempotency identity against stored metadata. This is a bounded dependency-free Eventing production hardening packet; prior unrelated TypeScript policy checks and absent generated proof do not close it.

WP12 is the final route/proof/PR gate. Its executable harness and canonical proof root are absent, and it cannot run honestly until WP09 integration acceptance, WP10 production consumer authority, WP11 hardening, and WP13 fresh layout validation are complete.

LAN WP15, WP18, and WP19 already supply the local durable registry, signed verification/freshness, and selected-route/revocation code needed for implementation. Their remaining manual proof does not block this code-first composition packet. WP26 newly owns the missing shipped peer ingress, durable receipt/idempotency custody, trust/route composition, and private Eventing WP10 authority handoff.

The shipped-call audit found real ActivityStore observation persistence, but no typed durable NetworkCascadeObligation, cascade table, or shipped composition owner. Eventing WP09 now has its bounded exact-source ingestion, deterministic phase identity, recovered durable journaling, reconciliation, projection-only reads, and direct-command authority negatives implemented with focused local evidence; final integration acceptance remains open. WP04 therefore still requires these direct owner handoffs for legal composition: Eventing WP09 network consumer chain; AI WP07 job queue and WP19 result journal; Policy WP05 ask-parent overrides and WP08 event model; Custody WP04 tombstone and WP06 report custody; Portal WP09 network surfaces and WP12 reports/notifications/custody. These dependencies do not claim any owner complete and keep WP04 blocked.

The source audit found that WP37 has no shipped owner for trusted tracking ingress, durable journal configuration, startup replay, or idempotent ActivityStore projection. WP40 is the explicit composition prerequisite; this review does not claim WP40 or WP37 implementation, tests, proof, or completion.

WP40 must consume the generic Eventing journal/replay foundation, canonical tracking contracts, the existing process-local detection cascade, and the ActivityStore projection boundary. The packet is a planned route only and does not claim production code, tests, proof, or readiness.
